purpose.zh: 练骨盆在侧面方向的控制

text.zh: 支撑腿站稳，另一侧骨盆慢慢提起
text.en: Stand firm on one leg and slowly lift the other side of your pelvis

text.zh: 轻扶椅子，抬起的膝盖保持弯曲
text.en: Hold the chair lightly and keep the lifted knee bent.

text.zh: 小幅度提起再回水平，身体不侧弯
text.en: Lift a little, return to level, and keep your trunk upright.

commonErrors.en: Side-bending the trunk instead of hitching the hip.
Bending and straightening the standing knee to help.

cautions.zh: 从每侧1组4次开始，舒适小幅度；腰髋膝疼痛或不稳即停
cautions.en: Start with one set of four per side in a small, comfortable range; stop if your back, hip or knee hurts or you feel unsteady.
